name: Head of agency or authorized official
description: Approves the voucher (Box D), the payment order, contracts and plans.

name: Head of the requesting office
description: Certifies Box A of the obligation request and of the voucher.

name: Planning and budget officer of the agency
description: Enters programs, projects and budget proposals.

name: Head of the budget unit
description: Checks the allotment, assigns the ORS number and certifies Box B of the ORS.

name: Chief accountant (head of the accounting unit)
description: Certifies funds available, examines claims, certifies Box C, keeps the books, certifies the payment order.

name: Cashier or disbursing officer
description: Signs the advice to debit the account, records payment orders with the NCA balance, prepares the daily reports.

name: Collecting officer
description: Issues official receipts, deposits collections, prepares the report of collections and deposits.

name: BAC, its Secretariat and technical working group
description: Conducts procurement and posts notices in PhilGEPS.

name: Inspection officer and property custodian
description: Inspect and accept deliveries; keep property records.

name: Personnel officer
description: Updates positions in GMIS and prepares the payroll.

name: Regional office or operating unit
description: Receives sub-allotments and shares of the NCA.

name: Program office of an agency that pays cash aid
Agency as a whole (central office)
description: The agency where the source does not name a unit.

name: Implementing body that receives transferred funds
description: Implements with funds of another agency and reports their use.

name: DBM (bureaus and approving officials)
description: Evaluates proposals, issues release documents and NCAs.

name: GPPB and its Technical Support Office
BIR office or approving official
description: Assesses taxes and decides refund claims.

name: COA audit team
description: Audits transactions and accounts after payment.

name: COA
description: Issues accounting rules and the annual reports.

name: DEPDev PIP and TRIP secretariats
description: Issue the call for the investment program.

name: BSP
description: Holds the TSA and settles payments.

name: Servicing bank
description: Checks and pays payment orders, reports to BTr.

name: Authorized agent bank or payment gateway
President
description: Submits the budget, signs the GAA.

name: Local chief executive
description: Prepares and executes the local budget.

name: Local treasurer, accountant and budget officer
Remittance receivers: BIR, GSIS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG
